name: client-funnel-html-workflow
title_zh: 客户访谈进、三页官网出，中间不问你一句
tagline_zh: 把访谈录音、Drive 素材、参考页和草稿，一次变成繁体中文首页+品牌故事+免费课落地页。视觉系统自动推导。
tagline_en: Turn interview notes, Drive files, ref pages & drafts into a TC homepage, brand story & lead page. Visual system.
desc_en: Turn client interviews, Drive source folders, brand references, example funnel pages, and existing draft copy into verified Traditional Chinese homepage, brand-story/about, and free-course landing-page HTML previews. Use when 你 asks to reproduce the structure of reference pages, improve incomplete website copy, derive a visual system, generate or optimize client imagery, build responsive static HT
why_zh: 不是模板套壳：它从参考页反推结构、从品牌资料提取视觉规则，再统一落到三页静态 HTML。
why_en: Not a template wrapper: it reverse-engineers ref-page structure, extracts visual rules from brand assets, and renders three.
limit_zh: 只吃 Google Drive 链接和已存文本，不接本地文件上传；只输出繁体中文静态 HTML 预览，不含部署。
limit_en: Accepts only Google Drive links & pasted text—no local uploads. Outputs static TC HTML previews only; no deploy, CMS, or form backend. Max 3.
title_en: Client interview in, 3-page site out, no questions asked
